A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] '''Padawan''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] selected her for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and residing at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple]] there, Master Gehnso dispatched her student to discover the cause of the native [[Flesh Raider]]s' violent attacks on the Jedi and the local settlement of [[Pilgrims]]. During her mission, the Padawan was slain by the natives and mourned by her master.<ref name="TOR" />
